name: mv_in_range
description: Returns `true` if at least one value of `field` is within the inclusive range `[lower, upper]`, using the natural order of the type. A null or empty field returns `false`, as does a null bound. Works on any ordered type: numbers, dates, IPs, versions, and strings (compared by their UTF-8 bytes).

params.name: field
params.description: Multivalue expression to test. If null or empty, the function returns `false`.

params.name: lower
params.description: Inclusive lower bound, of the same type as `field`. If null or multivalued, the function returns `false`.

params.name: upper
params.description: Inclusive upper bound, of the same type as `field`. If null or multivalued, the function returns `false`.
